title: Implement Workspace-First Architecture for SproutNet
objective: Refactor the existing collaboration model so that Workspace becomes the central entity for all collaboration features instead of Team. The current codebase already has workspaces, teams, conversations, messages, mentor_assignments, activity_logs, notifications, and workspace_files tables via the v2 migration. Now we need to extend this foundation into a full Workspace-first architecture.

databaseTables: workspaces (linked 1:1 to teams via team_id, has JSONB settings)
notifications (event_type, title, body, link_url, metadata JSONB, is_read)
activity_logs (workspace_id, actor_id, action_type, description, metadata JSONB)
apiRoutes: POST /api/teams/create (creates team + workspace + general channel + activity log)
POST /api/teams/join (invite code, adds to workspace channel, notifies leader)
POST /api/mentors/request (accept/reject; creates mentor_assignment + adds mentor to workspace channel)
appPages: /teams/[id] (team workspace portal with members, mentors, activity, chat)
/messages (unified messaging with conversation sidebar + realtime chat)
components: RealtimeChat (full realtime chat with reactions, attachments, typing indicators, threaded replies, search)
patterns: Server components: createClient() for auth + createAdminClient() for data (bypasses RLS)
Client components: createClient() from lib/supabase/client.ts for realtime subscriptions + direct queries
Admin client used everywhere for simplicity (even non-admin operations)
proxy.ts middleware (NOT middleware.ts) for auth routing

workspaceModel: Workspace has only team_id FK + settings JSONB — no name, description, status, or metadata fields
Workspace is passive; Team is still the visible entity
No workspace-level roles beyond leader/member on team_members
No workspace progress tracking (progress is tied to submissions, not workspace)
permissionsAndRoles: Permissions are hardcoded role checks (leader vs member vs mentor vs admin)
No RBAC table or permission system
apiEndpoints: No workspace update endpoint (name, description, status, etc.)
No file management endpoints beyond workspace_files
mentorTracking: mentor_assignments only has team_id, mentor_id, assigned_at
security: RLS policies are incomplete — many tables only have 1-2 sample policies
No policies on workspace_files, activity_logs, team_members, team_invites, team_join_requests
Admin client is used for ALL data access (even user-owned reads) bypassing RLS entirely
No rate limiting or spam prevention
conversations: No system conversation type in the CHECK constraint
No message_type field (text, image, file, system)
No edited_at or deleted_at on messages
audit: activity_logs exists but there's no platform-level audit_logs table for admin actions
No deletion tracking or soft deletes

current.description: Team is the primary entity visible to users. Workspace exists as a thin container with only settings JSONB.

target.description: Workspace becomes the primary entity. Team is a metadata attribute of Workspace. Members belong to Workspace. Channels, files, milestones, progress, announcements, and activity all belong to Workspace.

principles: Preserve existing tables; do not drop or rename them
Extend via new columns and new tables only
All existing API routes must continue working unchanged
Existing pages must render with zero modifications
Add new API routes alongside existing ones — never modify existing route handlers
The admin client pattern is intentional; do not replace it with RLS-dependent patterns
Inline styles and existing font conventions must be maintained

database.strategy: Extend existing tables with new columns. Add new tables where functionality is genuinely missing. Never drop or restructure existing columns.

workspaces.reason: Workspace is currently a stub with only team_id + settings. Needs full metadata to become the central entity.
addColumns: status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'forming', 'active', 'submitted', 'completed', 'archived', 'disbanded'))
visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team' CHECK (visibility IN ('team', 'public'))
created_by UUID REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
workspaces.backfillNote: Existing workspaces get default values on migration; all current workspaces remain functional.

team_members.reason: Needs co-leader role and workspace-level access for posters/mentors
addColumns: workspace_id UUID REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

mentor_assignments.reason: Needs tracking metadata for historical audit
addColumns: assigned_by UUID REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
assignment_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (assignment_status IN ('active', 'ended'))

messages.reason: Needs richer message typing and soft delete for moderation
addColumns: message_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text' CHECK (message_type IN ('text', 'image', 'file', 'system', 'announcement'))

conversation_members.reason: Unread count needs O(1) access for badge display
addColumns: notifications_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true

conversations.reason: System channel type needed for automated messages

team_invites.reason: Invites should reference workspace for consistency
addColumns: workspace_id UUID REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

team_join_requests.reason: Join requests should reference workspace for consistency
addColumns: workspace_id UUID REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

workspace_milestones.reason: Workspace needs its own milestone tracking independent of problem-level milestones. Problem milestones define requirements; workspace milestones track actual progress.
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
title TEXT NOT NULL
description TEXT
status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'skipped'))
due_date TIMESTAMPTZ
completed_by UUID REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

workspace_announcements.reason: Structured announcements with expiration and pinning support, separate from chat messages.
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
title TEXT NOT NULL
content TEXT NOT NULL
announcement_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general' CHECK (announcement_type IN ('general', 'poster', 'system', 'deadline'))
is_pinned BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

workspace_progress.reason: Tracks overall workspace progress percentage and current stage. Derivable from milestones but cached for O(1) reads.
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
workspace_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
progress_percentage INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
current_stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ideation'
last_submission_at TIMESTAMPTZ
reviewer_feedback TEXT
poster_feedback TEXT
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
workspace_progress.note: This table is updated by triggers on workspace_milestones and submissions for the workspace's team

audit_logs.reason: Platform-level admin audit trail separate from user-facing activity_logs. Used for moderation, debugging, and compliance.
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
actor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
action_type TEXT NOT NULL
entity_type TEXT NOT NULL
entity_id UUID
description TEXT NOT NULL
metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
ip_address TEXT
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

workspace_invites.reason: Clean invite model scoped to workspace rather than team. Replaces direct use of team_invites for workspace flows.
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
workspace_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
invited_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
email TEXT NOT NULL
role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member' CHECK (role IN ('member', 'co_leader'))
status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'expired'))
expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

newIndexes: idx_workspace_members_workspace ON public.team_members(workspace_id) WHERE workspace_id IS NOT NULL
idx_workspace_members_user ON public.team_members(user_id, workspace_id) WHERE workspace_id IS NOT NULL
idx_messages_conversation_deleted ON public.messages(conversation_id, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

rlsPolicies.strategy: Add comprehensive RLS policies that mirror the existing admin-client pattern as a fallback. Primary access control continues in application code (admin client). RLS is defense-in-depth, not the primary auth layer.
requiredPolicies: workspaces: SELECT if member/mentor/admin of linked team or user is admin
workspaces: UPDATE if leader of linked team or admin
workspace_milestones: SELECT if workspace member, INSERT/UPDATE if leader/co_leader/mentor
workspace_announcements: SELECT if workspace member, INSERT if leader/co_leader/poster/admin
workspace_progress: SELECT if workspace member, UPDATE if leader/mentor/poster
workspace_files: SELECT if workspace member, INSERT/DELETE if workspace member (own uploads) or leader
workspace_invites: SELECT/INSERT if workspace leader/co_leader, UPDATE if invited email user

apiEndpoints.strategy: Add new endpoints under /api/workspaces/. Do not modify existing endpoints in /api/teams/.

newEndpoints.handler: List workspaces for the current user (as member, leader, mentor, or poster)
Get workspace details including members, mentors, progress, recent activity
Update workspace name, description, status, visibility, max_members, max_mentors
Disband/archive workspace (soft delete, sets status to disbanded)
Change member role (leader can promote to co_leader, demote, etc.)
Current user leaves workspace (fails if leader — must transfer first)
Transfer workspace leadership to another member
Get paginated activity log for workspace
List workspace files with pagination and category filter
Create workspace invite (generates code or sends email)
Assign mentor to workspace (wraps mentor_assignments + adds to channels)
Delete/archive a channel (cannot delete general channel)

permissions.strategy: Implement a role-permission lookup table that future features can extend without code changes. Keep the existing hardcoded checks as a fallback.

tables.name: workspace_roles
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name IN ('leader', 'co_leader', 'member', 'mentor', 'poster', 'admin'))
description TEXT
is_system BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

tables.name: workspace_role_permissions
columns: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
role_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workspace_roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
permission TEXT NOT NULL
UNIQUE(role_id, permission)
tables.reason: Maps roles to granular permissions without hardcoding

checkFunction.name: check_workspace_permission
checkFunction.signature: check_workspace_permission(p_user_id UUID, p_workspace_id UUID, p_permission TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN
checkFunction.note: Optional; can also be implemented in application code via a helper function

folderStructure.existing: Do not restructure existing folders. Only add new ones.

newFolders.note: Future UI pages — not needed in Phase 1 architecture phase

teams/[id]/page.tsx.changes: Minimal. Add a redirect or wrapper that fetches workspace data and passes it to a new WorkspaceClient component (extracted from TeamWorkspaceClient). The workspace becomes the primary data source.
teams/[id]/page.tsx.preserve: All existing props and rendering must continue to work

dashboard/page.tsx.changes: Add workspace cards next to enrolled problems. Show active workspaces with progress percentage, member count, and last activity.
dashboard/page.tsx.preserve: Existing enrolled problems list must remain unchanged

implementationOrder.name: API routes — workspace CRUD + members

implementationOrder.name: API routes — milestones, announcements, progress, activity, files, invites, mentors, channels
Integrate with existing pages
implementationOrder.description: Update dashboard to show workspaces, update teams/[id] to use workspace as primary entity, add workspace data to existing flows.

implementationOrder.name: Update proxy.ts middleware
implementationOrder.description: Add workspace routes to public/protected route lists if needed. Add mentor workspace access routes.

whatNotToDo: Do NOT modify any existing API route handlers in app/api/teams/, app/api/enrollments/, app/api/problems/, app/api/submissions/, app/api/blogs/, app/api/mentors/
Do NOT drop or rename any existing database columns or tables
Do NOT change the existing authentication flow
Do NOT replace the admin client pattern — it is intentional for this project
Do NOT add Tailwind utility classes — use inline styles matching existing conventions
Do NOT implement UI in this phase unless it is minimal wiring (the prompt is architecture-only)
Do NOT create a messaging system redesign — conversations and realtime chat are already implemented

futureCompatibility.designPrinciple: Every decision must enable forward-compatibility with:
futureModules: Kanban board (workspace has milestones with status → natural Kanban)
Calendar (workspace milestones have due_date → calendar events)
AI Mentor (workspace activity + milestones + progress → AI context)
Video meetings (workspace channels can hold meeting links, WebRTC room IDs)
Shared documents (workspace files + rich content → collaborative docs)
Wiki (workspace announcements with markdown + pinned → wiki pages)
Task management (workspace milestones granular → tasks with assignees)
Issue tracking (workspace activity + messages → issue system)
GitHub integration (workspace metadata stores repo URL, webhook events)

verification: Existing npm run dev must start without errors
Existing npm run build must complete without errors
Existing npm run lint must pass
All existing API routes must return their original responses unchanged
New API routes must be testable via curl/Postman
The v2 migration SQL must run without errors against a fresh Supabase instance
deliverables: 1. Database migration SQL file (extends existing schema, never breaks it)
2. lib/workspace/ helper modules (permissions, activity, members, progress, notifications)
4. Updated dashboard and workspace pages (minimal UI wiring)
